# Zed file icons

SVGs copied from [zed-industries/zed](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed) `assets/icons/file_icons`
(Apache-2.0). `fill`/`stroke` black → `currentColor` for theme tinting.

Review Desk tints each glyph with a Seti/VS Code–style brand color in
`file_icons.rs` (`file_icon_color` / `dir_icon_color`) so types stay readable
on dark chrome (Zed’s built-in panel uses muted monochrome for these SVGs).
